prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A highly detailed, stylized scene featuring a green-skinned, smiling female orc character dressed as a cowgirl. She stands confidently on a wooden desk, holding a cardboard sign that reads "NEED BUZZ." Her outfit includes a brown cowboy hat, a tan sleeveless shirt, brown leather vest, matching pants, and sturdy boots, with a holster and belt completing the Western look. The orc’s expression is cheerful and inviting, with prominent tusks and expressive eyes. Behind her, a computer monitor displays a grayscale 3D sculpt of the same character in a similar pose, emphasizing the digital-to-physical creative process. To the right of the figure, a product box features full-color artwork of the orc, matching the physical model. The background is a softly lit, neutral-toned office or studio space, with warm, even lighting that highlights the textures and colors of the figure. The composition is clean and focused, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the orc figure and her playful, charismatic presence, evoking a sense of creativity and character design in a modern workspace.
